routeStrategy.reason: maximize exact target routes independently; the strict intersection remains a separate fail-closed metric and must not be widened by semantic downgrades

capabilityMatrix.rule: schema identity must come from an explicit digest-bound namespace profile
preserve source quote intent and use the target quote character
plain JSON only; PostgreSQL JSONB binary semantics are never downgraded
PostgreSQL JSONB is exact only on PostgreSQL; it is never downgraded to JSON or TEXT
element type, indexing, comparison and NULL semantics must all match
predicate and NULL filtering semantics must be native and exact
LOWER and one-level JSON text-path keys are retained in typed IR; target collation/JSON semantics must be proven
timing, event, row/statement scope, OLD/NEW and action ABI are typed
ENABLE/FORCE/DISABLE/NO FORCE state is retained only on PostgreSQL; RLS is never downgraded to ordinary privileges
PERMISSIVE FOR ALL TO PUBLIC, USING and WITH CHECK are typed; current_setting key and missing_ok semantics are retained and never lowered to grants
rerun behavior is never emulated by DROP or another destructive statement

object scope and required source type/catalogue evidence must be retained; SQL Server role comments use database-principal extended properties; MySQL function comments require a unique typed routine identity
routine signatures may be omitted only after the source catalog proves one exact overload
